description: This is a test class for the TimeReportAPI in the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically testing project report API endpoints using integration test framework. It includes test cases for retrieving a single report and placeholders for delete and update operations.

classes.name: ProjectReportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that tests the Project Report API endpoints in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, including retrieval of single reports and handling of unimplemented delete and update methods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single project report via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testGetOne method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures the delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures the validation rule for delete is not implemented.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures the update operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Ensures the validation rule for update is not implemented.
